name: computer/screenshot-explain
title: Explain the screen
summary: Take a screenshot, describe what is on screen and answer a question about it.
when: Use when the user asks what is on their screen or what an error window says.
steps: Call screenshot with a clear filename such as screenshots/screen-2026-11-13.png and keep the returned path.
Call describe_image with that path and the user's question, so the answer targets the question and not the whole scene.
Call delegate with capability vision and image_path when the screen needs a second, longer reading.
Call screenshot again if a dialog covers the question or the first image is blurry, then ask describe_image once more.
Read the exact window titles and error text from the answer and check they match what describe_image reported.
If the screen is locked, blank or unreadable, say so plainly and ask for the window to be brought forward.
Answer with what is on screen, the exact text found and the next step; never guess text the image does not show.
next: The final answer must describe what the screen shows, quote the exact text found and give the next step for the user.
